subject: 올림포스 영어독해 9대 변별유형 실전모의
title: 실전모의 1회 148번: Avoiding Loss: A Powerful Motivator
fullPassage: In a classic experiment conducted by Nobel laureate Daniel Kahneman, winning $100 was found to be half as appealing as losing $100 is unappealing. In a similar vein, participants in a research study were given a lottery ticket and then asked if they would trade their ticket for a different one with an equal chance of winning. Fewer than half of the participants agreed — even when they were bribed by chocolate. When the experiment was repeated with pens instead of lottery tickets, 90 percent of participants agreed to trade. People hang on to those lottery tickets in order to avoid the regret they'd experience if they were to switch and their original ticket won. From a marketing perspective, it makes sense that if you give someone $100 to be applied toward a future purchase, she'll find this a greater incentive than a $100 discount.
